meta.name: Peru
meta.blurb: Seven frontiers from the Putumayo to Tacna. Restore the Inca realm of the four quarters.
meta.pitch: a 1936 grand-strategy war map of Peru
meta.capitalFalls: The government leaves Lima for the sierra and sits at Cuzco. The war goes on.
meta.capitalFreed: Lima is free again. The government comes down from the sierra to the City of the Kings.

landmarks.desc: Enter Quito, the northern end of the Qhapaq Ñan
Reach Tiwanaku and stand before the Gate of the Sun

medalNames.ten: Order of the Sun of Peru

days.text: Inti Raymi. The sun turns back toward us on every front.
Felices Fiestas Patrias. Firme y feliz por la unión.
Angamos Day. The Navy remembers the Huáscar.
Ayacucho Day. The Army keeps the field it won in 1824.

meta.motto: Ama sua, ama llulla, ama qella — “Do not steal, do not lie, do not be idle.”
